title: Reconfiguring Zn deposition dynamics via an epitaxial Zn2+ pathway in profiled viscose rayon for long-cyclability zinc-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00052A, Paper
Sainan Ou, Jiaxian Zheng, Xingshu Chen, Ran Li, Zhanhui Yuan, Shude Liu, Yao Niu, Meng An, Ge Zhou, Yusuke Yamauchi, Xinxiang Zhang
Profiled viscose rayon with surface grooves shows excellent ability in reconfiguring the Zn deposition dynamics of AZIBs for long cycles, providing a novel strategy for separator design to induce uniform growth of Zn crystals along the (002) plane.
